incidents.summary: Rightmove faces a collective legal claim alleging excessive and unfair subscription fees, with a tribunal hearing scheduled for 2–3 November 2026.

sources.title: Date set for £1.5bn Rightmove court hearing
sources.quote: It claims that Rightmove abused its dominant position in the online property portal market by charging excessive and unfair fees to estate agents that list properties on its online portal.

sources.title: Date set for £1.5bn Rightmove court hearing
sources.quote: The court hearing has been ordered by the Competition Appeal Tribunal for 2nd and 3rd November this year.

sources.title: Rightmove’s £1.6B Antitrust Headache | Jones Day
sources.quote: The action seeks aggregate damages on behalf of an estimated 7,200 members who paid for Rightmove's services over a six-year period—primarily small businesses such as estate agents, letting agents, and new homes developers.
